headline: Building a playable FireMUD
orientation: Follow the main workstreams here and see when paused work should resume. Open PR Delivery for current reviews and merges; follow the linked domain trackers for detailed implementation and proof status.

tracks.name: Decisions and contract ownership
tracks.purpose: Establish what FireMUD is building and which design source owns each contract.
tracks.now: The broad human ADR review and accepted-decision application are complete foundations. ADR 0183 remains a pending proposal, so its choice is not settled.
tracks.milestone: Keep accepted decisions aligned with the owning architecture as implementation exposes gaps.
tracks.return_when: A consequential new design conflict appears, or the pending ADR 0183 decision is brought for human review.

phases.name: Capability map and human ADR review
Apply accepted decisions and assign contract owners

tracks.name: Implementation-first corpus alignment
tracks.purpose: Bring accepted pre-v1 behavior, architecture, code and proof into agreement across the whole product.
tracks.now: Document is building Account and Game Session authority prerequisites around Unit 1B. Earlier section reviews and fixes remain useful; sections with required behavior or essential proof open stay provisional.
tracks.milestone: Implement known prerequisites, then assess each section with two fresh independent whole-section reviews before claiming corpus completion.
tracks.return_when: Return to every provisional section as its dependency or proof clears; repeat the sweep until the whole corpus is consistent.

phases.name: Catch up known required pre-v1 work

tracks.name: Playable delivery and live proof
tracks.state: REPOSITORY SLICE PUBLISHED · LIVE PROOF OPEN
tracks.purpose: Make the reviewed build safely reachable and demonstrate a real player journey on hosted infrastructure.
tracks.now: Gate 1 preview enablement is merged. Gate 2 repository work is published in #2853, but protected credentials and CA setup, certificate and consumer convergence, CNI, and Telnet/WebSocket LOGIN → PLAY → LOOK proof remain open.
tracks.milestone: Run the protected, exact-deployment player journey and record the live evidence, including post-merge develop and dev-demo confirmation.
tracks.return_when: The protected environment and its credential/CA prerequisites are available on a coherent deployed head.

tracks.name: Shared foundations and simplification
tracks.purpose: Converge cross-service pre-v1 contracts after the playable repository slice.
tracks.now: The dev-demo summary parser and presence/privacy work joined the published tail. Remaining Phase 1 candidates intersect Account, Gameplay and publication work, so there is no independent active slice yet.
tracks.milestone: Choose the next coherent shared-foundation slice after those owner dependencies settle; service-local maintainability follows in Phase 2.
tracks.return_when: Document's Account admission work and Gameplay's publication contract settle enough for General to take a separate shared-service fix without duplicating either lane.

tracks.name: Review and merge train
tracks.purpose: Move published work through review, corrections, CI and human merge in dependency order.
tracks.now: Gameplay owns the configured Hosted and CLI review queue. General is helping with downstream preparation and the #2879 sizing split; Document owns its implementation tail.
tracks.milestone: Keep each channel moving to its next safe candidate and present coherent, reviewed heads for human merge.
tracks.return_when: Continuous while the published stack remains; consult the PR delivery page for the current front and exact queue.

phases.name: Review and fix the current front

return_points.name: Provisional corpus sections
return_points.trigger: An owner prerequisite or essential proof lands; Document reassesses from the current code and contracts.

return_points.name: Protected playable proof
return_points.trigger: Credential/CA setup and a coherent hosted deployment are available for the Gate 2 player journey.

return_points.name: Shared-foundation Phase 1
return_points.trigger: Resume General's shared-contract work after Document's Account admission and Gameplay's publication changes have a clear, stable boundary.

return_points.name: Service-local Phase 2
return_points.trigger: Shared-foundation Phase 1 is settled and a concrete maintainability slice is selected.

return_points.name: ADR 0183
return_points.trigger: Bring the pending proposal to human review; do not treat it as accepted meanwhile.

parked_note: Other recovery, replay, scheduler and design-correction candidates are tracked in their owning sections or implementation trackers. They are not a separately approved delivery phase; pull them forward when their owner boundary is reached.

domains.name: Player Access and Session
domains.note: Account and profile identity work; membership, binding, reconnect, takeover and recovery remain partial.

domains.name: Player Experience
domains.note: Command paths exist; presentation, social/safety, history and browser experience remain partial.

domains.name: Gameplay Rules
domains.note: Item and bounded effect paths exist; crafting, broader actions and combat remain incomplete.

domains.name: World Runtime
domains.note: Room, movement and draft topology slices exist; authoritative location and lifecycle convergence remain open.

domains.name: Game Authoring
domains.note: Publication control plane is strongest; creator UX, full authoring, readiness and playtest remain open.

domains.name: Realm Routing
domains.note: Catalog and bootstrap substrate exist; route authority, grants and playtest lifecycle remain incomplete.

domains.name: Automation
domains.note: Durable ingress and scheduling slices exist; recovery, handler contracts and wider firing remain gaps.

domains.name: Game Session Runtime
domains.note: Session and tick substrate exists; ownership fencing, Redis-loss recovery and canonical status remain open.

domains.name: Shared Runtime
domains.note: Shared persistence and auth primitives exist; adoption, replay and retention convergence remain open.

domains.name: Platform Operations
domains.note: Delivery foundations exist; hosted proof, recovery, degraded operations and readiness remain partial.
